summary: This component renders a share button that links to Bluesky with pre-filled text containing the article title and URL. It first checks whether a Bluesky record key exists (which would mean sharing is disabled) and validates that required metadata is present before building and returning the link.

explanations.18: This hook gives us access to the Docusaurus site configuration, which includes things like the base URL of the site.
explanations.19: This uses optional chaining (?.) to safely dig into nested properties — if any level is missing or null, the whole expression just becomes undefined instead of crashing.
explanations.21: The logic here is inverted: if the record key exists, we return null (render nothing). This is likely a guard clause to skip rendering when sharing has been explicitly disabled.
explanations.28: We're building a Bluesky share intent URL — it's like a template link that opens Bluesky's compose window with pre-filled text.
explanations.29: encodeURIComponent() converts special characters (like spaces and slashes) into URL-safe codes so they don't break the link when embedded in a URL.
explanations.37: target='_blank' makes the link open in a new tab or window instead of replacing the current page.
explanations.38: rel='noopener noreferrer' is a security measure that prevents the new page from accessing the window object of the page that opened it.
